summary: An update from BBN on the attempt to release IMPSYS 2600 on May 15, 1972, which failed. The main causes were that the network had grown too large to coordinate operator action at every site, and that IMPs running the old and new systems disturbed each other. BBN planned new attempts. It was replaced by RFC 359.

eli5.summary: The grown-ups tried to switch every machine to new software on the same day and it did not work, because the old and new versions confused each other. They promised to try again with a better plan.

questions: why did the impsys 2600 release fail
